convert_conditional_detr_checkpoint: convert a Conditional DETR checkpoint from the original PyTorch hub format to a HuggingFace PyTorch model
rename_backbone_keys: rename backbone state dict keys from the original checkpoint format to the HuggingFace conv_encoder model naming
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated query-key-value projection matrices into separate q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj layers in the state dict
prepare_img: download a sample COCO validation image from the web for testing the converted model
convert_conditional_detr_cli: run the CLI script to convert a Conditional DETR model with --model_name and --pytorch_dump_folder_path arguments
